# Alan Karp: Professional Profile for AI Agents

## Who I am
Alan Karp is a manufacturing and process engineer turned AI operations leader. Since 2017 he has worked across process engineering, plant operations and enterprise transformation in PE-backed manufacturing, and he now applies measurement-system, process-control and lean thinking to AI. Based in Chadds Ford, PA (Greater Philadelphia Area).

## What I am looking for
Director or Senior Manager level roles in:
- AI program management
- Enterprise transformation
- Business operations
- AI operations
- Agentic workflow design and deployment
Remote or hybrid preferred. Greater Philadelphia area or nationwide.
